blocks.description: Repairs all units in its vicinity. Requires ozone.

blocks.name: Unloader
blocks.description: Unloads items from nearby blocks in any direction. Output can be filtered to unload only specific items.

blocks.name: Vault
blocks.description: Stores a large amount of items of each type. Expands storage when placed next to a core. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

blocks.name: Vent Condenser
blocks.description: Condenses vent gases into water. Consumes power.

blocks.name: Water Extractor
blocks.description: Extracts groundwater. Used in locations with no surface water available.

blocks.name: Wave
blocks.description: Fires streams of liquid at enemies. Automatically extinguishes fires when supplied with water.

blocks.name: World Cell
blocks.description: A memory cell for use in mapmaking. Cannot be destroyed.

blocks.name: World Message
blocks.description: A message block for use in mapmaking. Cannot be destroyed.

blocks.name: World Processor
blocks.description: A processor for use in mapmaking. Cannot be destroyed. Capable of using privileged instructions, such as those that spawn units or change tiles.

blocks.name: World Switch
blocks.description: A switch block for use in mapmaking. Cannot be destroyed. Can only be interacted by players on the same team.
